Why is Krishna's flute hollow? Of all things, an empty stick of bamboo. As the story goes, Krishna walked into a garden, and every plant wanted to be chosen. The rose said, take me. The mango tree said, take me.
But Krishna stopped at a tall bamboo. Will you give me your life? The bamboo trembled. Then it whispered, yes. So Krishna cut it down, hollowed out its heart, and pierced it with holes.
Wait, why would anyone agree to that? Because then Krishna put it to his lips, and it made the sweetest music the world had ever heard. Cows came running. The river slowed down to listen.
That's why the flute is hollow. When we empty ourselves of pride, he can play his music through us. Comment Muralidhar if you can hear him.
